target_customer: US K-12 schools and districts that buy after-school and enrichment programs, originally parents booking lessons
problem: Schools and parents struggle to find, vet and manage enrichment instructors and activities; HOKALI supplies staffed programs and a platform for enrollment, payments and attendance.
business_model: B2B program delivery and marketplace commissions on bookings, plus management software for schools

founders.name: Ignacio Viau
education: Qualified lawyer (school not stated on YC page)
previous_startups: Three earlier startups (names not given on YC page)
founders.background_notes: Business development and sales background per YC page.

founders.name: Tomas Bisi
education: 42 Silicon Valley University, Master's in Computer Science
founders.background_notes: Prior CTO, product manager and developer roles per YC page; employers not named.

competitors.name: Outschool
competitors.what: Marketplace of online classes for kids
competitors.funding_then: 75M Series C in April 2021 and 110M Series D at 3B valuation in October 2021

competitors.name: Sawyer
competitors.what: Booking platform for kids' activities, positioned as an OpenTable for kids' activities
competitors.traction_then: over 5.1M bookings by education partners in 2021 per its February 2022 trend report

technical_complexity.rationale: Booking, payments and attendance software is standard; the hard part is operations and vetting instructors, not engineering.

defensibility.rationale: Marketplaces and school software are copyable; district relationships and instructor supply give some stickiness.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No source shows incumbents absorbing HOKALI, which was still active in 2025.

market_need_then: Schools reopening after the pandemic needed enrichment and aftercare providers; the sources give no spend figures, so demand evidence is limited to the company's growth claims (240+ to 1,099 school and district partners, sources disagree).

branding.domain_note: Uses hokali.com; acquisition history not found.

identity.voice_and_tone: Inspirational education language: Every child carries a spark of greatness

branding.community_and_virality: Press features in 2024 (USA Today, Digital Journal, LA Weekly per YC page; Grit Daily and Blue Startups profiles); no evidence of community or virality.

brand_strength.rationale: Coined, trademarked name (filed February 2021 per a trademark record, no foreign meaning) with modest press; no evidence it drove growth.

pivots.from: Consumer (B2C) platform to help parents find instructors and sports lessons
pivots.to: B2B model serving schools and districts
pivots.why: Per a Grit Daily profile snippet, the founders moved toward schools; exact date and reason not found.

outcome_analysis: HOKALI started as a consumer marketplace for lessons and shifted to selling onsite enrichment and aftercare to schools and districts, which the company says has grown to hundreds of partner schools. It is still active with 12 people, but funding is only visible through aggregators, so how well capitalized it is remains unknown. The B2B shift and school relationships are the main positives; the commodity nature of booking software is the risk.
notes: Unverified funding from aggregators only: Seedtable lists a 500K pre-seed in December 2021 with YC, Blue Startups, Nomad Ventures; VCBacked lists Goodwater Capital and others and a May 2025 seed of undisclosed size and another profile 5.6M; Simplify says about 170K. These conflict so no round is recorded. Partner count conflicts (240+ vs 1,099). Founding year 2020 per YC.
